relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` change the atm-bd-orchestration sprint-family pour or metadata on its generated beads? Judge overlap with `anchor.scope` only.

criteria.yes: The item changes the sprint-family pour, bead creation, or metadata on generated dev, fix, sanity, or QA beads.
criteria.no: The item concerns another activity and would not affect this pour or its generated beads.
criteria.unclear: The item does not identify which pour or bead family it affects.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` affirmatively plan to copy pr_target from the sprint container to every generated dev, fix, sanity, and QA bead at pour time, as `anchor.statement` requires? Judge presence only.

criteria.yes: The text names pr_target and requires its value on each generated dev, fix, sanity, and QA bead when poured.
criteria.no: The text is silent about pr_target, mentions it only generally, or lacks the full set of generated beads or pour-time copy.
criteria.unclear: The text promises pr_target propagation but does not establish which generated beads receive it or when.

contradicted.instructions: Does an explicit decision in `item.text` prevent the pr_target copy required by `anchor.statement`? Mere silence or incomplete detail is no conflict.

criteria.yes: The item states that a required generated bead lacks pr_target, receives it only after pour, or derives it later instead of storing the copied value.
criteria.no: No incompatible choice is stated; silence and general metadata mentions count as no conflict.
criteria.unclear: A stated timing or recipient might conflict, but the text does not settle it.
